subtitle.en: After four years at NVIDIA working on tessellation, Ignacio moves on to work with Jon Blow on The Witness.
subtitle.zh: 在 NVIDIA 做了四年多曲面细分之后，他转去和 Jon Blow 一起做《The Witness》。

translator.note: 只翻译正文，不译评论区：源文正文到「In clockwise order: …Tristan.」为止，紧随其后的「4 Comments」及四条读者留言（Jesús、repi、sam、Greg James，共 14 个源文单元）属于归档附带的评论区，按本批口径不计入正文，也不在译文里；保真核验报出的未覆盖单元全部来自这一段。正文全部覆盖：唯一一处插图按全站口径归一化成图片占位块，丢掉 srcset 与尺寸缩略图后缀。

blocks.en: Last Friday was my last day at NVIDIA. Next Monday I’ll start working with [Jon Blow](http://www.number-none.com/blow/) on [The Witness](http://the-witness.net). I’m excited to get back to the game industry and I’m hoping something really cool will come out of this.
blocks.zh: 上周五是我在 NVIDIA 的最后一天。下周一我就开始和 [Jon Blow](http://www.number-none.com/blow/) 一起做[《The Witness》](http://the-witness.net)了。能回到游戏行业我很兴奋，也希望这件事最后能做出点真正酷的东西。

blocks.en: In any case, I had a great time working at NVIDIA during the last 4+ years; I especially enjoyed the time I spent working on tessellation. I’ll definitely miss the great people that I had the chance to work with. Some of them are in the following picture of my last day at work:
blocks.zh: 总之，在 NVIDIA 这四年多我过得很愉快，尤其是做曲面细分那段时间。我一定会想念那些有机会共事的优秀同事。下面这张我离职那天的合影里就有几位：

blocks.en: In clockwise order: Aravind, James, Tianyun, Eric, Sarah, Ignacio (not me), Cem, Lars, Timothy, Philippe, Matthieu, Paulius and Tristan.
blocks.zh: 按顺时针方向依次是：Aravind、James、Tianyun、Eric、Sarah、Ignacio（不是我）、Cem、Lars、Timothy、Philippe、Matthieu、Paulius 和 Tristan。
